query: 'SELECT
    a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
    p.paciente_key,
    d.departamento_key,
    dx.diagnostico_key,
    CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.admission_date, 112)) AS fecha_ingreso_key,
    CASE
        WHEN a.discharge_date IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.discharge_date, 112))
    END AS fecha_alta_key,
    a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id,
    CASE
        WHEN a.discharge_date IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE DATEDIFF(DAY, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date)
    END AS dias_estancia,
    1 AS conteo_admisiones
FROM silver.admissions a
INNER JOIN gold.dim_paciente p
    ON p.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id
INNER JOIN gold.dim_departamento d
    ON d.nombre_departamento = a.department
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        x.admission_id,
        x.icd_code,
        x.diagnosis_description,
        x.severity
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            admission_id,
            icd_code,
            diagnosis_description,
            severity,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY admission_id
                ORDER BY diagnosis_id
            ) AS rn
        FROM silver.diagnoses
    ) x
    WHERE x.rn = 1
) dx_s
    ON dx_s.admission_id = a.admission_id
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico dx
    ON dx.codigo_icd = dx_s.icd_code
    AND ISNULL(dx.descripcion_patologia, '') =
        ISNULL(dx_s.diagnosis_description, '')
    AND dx.nivel_severidad =
        COALESCE(dx_s.severity, 'No especificado')
WHERE a.admission_date IS NOT NULL',
